title: Add Codex Fast mode support
outcome: Expose Codex's catalog-advertised Fast service tier as session-scoped TermAl authority. Persist and hydrate the setting, send serviceTier on Codex app-server thread/turn requests, provide settings and slash-command controls, surface effective state, and cover backend/frontend behavior without enabling Fast for unsupported models.
acceptance: Codex sessions show Fast only when the active model catalog advertises it; users can toggle it from settings and /fast; the choice persists and is included in subsequent app-server requests; changing to an unsupported model safely disables Fast; remote sessions proxy the setting; relevant Rust and UI tests pass.
